description: Get a daily or instantaneous time series for one USGS site and parameter over a date range, as time-ordered value records. A site can hold several series for one query — one per daily statistic (mean, maximum, minimum) and one per sensor (method); this returns one, reporting its statCd and methodId (its time-series ID), and lists the rest in otherSeries so any can be re-requested with the statCd and methodId inputs. By default it returns the daily mean when one carries values, and the method with the most records. Large sets (>500 records) return the most recent records inline with truncated=true — the last 500 without DataCanvas, and with DataCanvas enabled the complete series also spills to a canvas (canvas_id/table_name): inspect the staged table with water_dataframe_describe, then read the full series with water_dataframe_query. Use water_find_sites and water_list_parameters to resolve inputs; water_get_site_data_catalog lists a site’s series with their record bounds (beginDate/endDate), and a row’s timeSeriesId works as methodId.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from a prior call to add this series as a table on an existing canvas rather than creating a new one. Each distinct site, parameter code, series type, date range, and selected statistic and method gets its own table name, so re-running the identical query replaces its own table while a different query adds another alongside it. Applies only when the series spills to a canvas. Omit to start a fresh canvas.

methodId.description: Time-series ID of the series to return (the OGC time_series_id, 32 hexadecimal characters) — the methodId or an otherSeries[].methodId from a prior response for the same site, parameter, and seriesType, or a timeSeriesId from water_get_site_data_catalog whose seriesType matches this call. Omit for the method with the most records, ties going to the site’s default sensor (methodDescription null) over a labeled one such as an auxiliary gage, then to the series that began first. Each daily statistic and the instantaneous series of one sensor carry different IDs. A numeric NWIS method ID matches no series.

parameterCd.description: A single 5-digit USGS parameter code (e.g. "00060" for discharge, "00065" for gage height). One code per call — this tool returns one series. Use water_list_parameters to discover available codes.

seriesType.description: "daily" returns one value per day (typically mean/max/min). "instantaneous" returns ~15-minute readings. Default: "daily". Use "instantaneous" for high-resolution analysis.

site.description: USGS site number (8–15 digits, e.g. "01646500" for Potomac River at Little Falls). Use water_find_sites to discover valid site numbers.

statCd.description: Daily statistic to return, as a 5-digit USGS statistic code: "00003" mean, "00001" maximum, "00002" minimum. Omit for the mean when one carries values, otherwise the lowest-numbered statistic that has values; the response names the one returned and lists the others in otherSeries. Daily series only — instantaneous values carry just "00000" ("00011", the statistic water_get_site_data_catalog lists on instantaneous rows, reads the same).

name: water_get_series

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID for the DataCanvas holding the full time series. Present only when truncated=true and DataCanvas is enabled. Pass to water_dataframe_describe then water_dataframe_query.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_data_for_range`: The site and parameter combination has no data in the requested date range. `invalid_date_range`: endDate is before startDate, or a date passes the YYYY-MM-DD shape check but is not a real calendar date. `invalid_stat_cd`: statCd is not a 5-digit USGS statistic code. Raised before any upstream request. `stat_cd_for_instantaneous`: statCd names a daily statistic but seriesType is "instantaneous", whose values carry only statistic "00000". Raised before any upstream request. `method_not_found`: No series returned for this query carries the requested methodId (within the requested statCd, when one is given). A numeric NWIS method ID always lands here: methodId is the 32-character OGC time-series ID. `invalid_request`: The USGS Water Data API rejected the request. Input formats are validated before the call, so this surfaces a value that is well-formed but unacceptable upstream. `upstream_error`: The USGS Water Data API returned a server error or a response it could not read, and retrying did not clear it. `upstream_timeout`: The upstream requests, retries included, ran past the 45-second budget for this call. `canvas_not_found`: The supplied canvas_id names a canvas that never existed or has expired. Raised before any upstream request, so no upstream call is spent on it. `canvas_capacity_exhausted`: canvas_id was omitted and a fresh canvas was needed to stage the series, but this tenant already holds the maximum number of active canvases. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

methodDescription.description: Description of the sensor, built from the series metadata as "<sublocation>, [<web description>]" (e.g. "From multiparameter sonde, [Discontinued]"), or either part alone when the other is blank (e.g. "From multiparameter sonde", "[Radar]"). Null when the metadata leaves both blank, as it does for the default series at most single-sensor sites.

methodId.description: Time-series ID of the series returned — the OGC time_series_id, the same value water_get_site_data_catalog lists as timeSeriesId. Pass it back as the methodId input to request this series again. Null only when the upstream sent the series without an ID.

notice.description: Advisory about this result: the staged canvas table and how to read it, the advice to narrow the date range when the series was truncated with no canvas available, or the fact that a supplied canvas_id went unused because nothing was staged.

otherSeries.description: Every other statistic × method series returned for this query, a series with no records in the range included (recordCount 0), ordered by statistic code, then first observation — re-request one with its statCd and methodId. Empty when the query produced a single series.

items.description: One series returned for this query that was not selected.

methodDescription.description: Description of the sensor; null when blank.

methodId.description: Time-series ID of this series — pass as the methodId input.

recordCount.description: Number of value records this series holds over the requested range.

statCd.description: USGS statistic code of this series (e.g. "00001").

statName.description: Statistic name for statCd (e.g. "Maximum"); null when the upstream gives none.

parameterName.description: Parameter description from the USGS parameter-code catalog, units included (e.g. "Discharge, cubic feet per second").

query.description: Query parameters used for this request.

statCd.description: USGS statistic code of the returned series: "00003" daily mean, "00001" daily maximum, "00002" daily minimum, "00000" for instantaneous values.

statName.description: Statistic name for statCd (e.g. "Mean", "Maximum"). Null when the upstream gives none, as for instantaneous values.

table_name.description: DuckDB table name in the canvas holding all records. Present when canvas_id is present. Use as the FROM target in water_dataframe_query SQL.

totalRecords.description: Total number of records in the upstream result set (before any truncation).

truncated.description: True when the result exceeds 500 records and only the most recent were returned inline. When canvas_id is present, inspect the staged table with water_dataframe_describe then read the full series with water_dataframe_query; otherwise narrow the date range.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure for all values in this series (e.g. "ft3/s", "ft", "deg C").

values.description: Time-ordered value records, oldest first within the slice. Holds every record when truncated is false; when truncated, the most recent records only — the last 500 without DataCanvas, or the last N that fit the inline preview budget when the full series is staged on a canvas.

items.description: A single value record with date-time, value, and qualifiers.

dateTime.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time of this observation.

qualifiers.description: Data qualifier codes for this value: the approval code first, then one per qualifier.

items.description: A USGS data qualifier code (e.g. "P" = provisional, "A" = approved, "e" = estimated). A qualifier with no code is the upstream word as written (e.g. "OTHERAGENCY").

value.description: Measured value as a string. Empty string when the upstream reported no value for that interval — qualifiers then give the reason (e.g. "Ssn" seasonal, "Dis" discontinued, "Dry", "Eqp" equipment malfunction). A staged canvas table holds NULL for these.

title: Water Get Series
